run_esm2_inference_with_fsdp_cpu_offload: run ESM-2 15B model inference with FSDP wrapper and CPU offloading for reduced GPU memory usage
init_torch_distributed_process_group: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group with NCCL backend and world size 1 for single-node setup
download_esm2_model_and_regression_data: download the ESM-2 pretrained model data and regression data from the HuggingFace hub using esm.pretrained
load_esm2_model_with_alphabet_core: load an ESM-2 model and its alphabet from downloaded model data using esm.pretrained.load_model_and_alphabet_core
wrap_model_layers_with_fsdp: wrap each transformer layer of an ESM-2 model individually with FSDP for memory-efficient sharded inference
